name: Reocín (Spain)
description: White field with a red diagonal band at the lower hoist and a blue diagonal band at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Reocín (a figure and a mine on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Reocín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Reocín arms — figure and mine on blue
